verdict.rationale: Puzzle's marketing and pricing pages reference bank/card integrations (Ramp, Brex, Stripe) with auto-categorization rates and read-only data connections, and community feedback confirms real-time bank account integration is a standout feature. However, there's no first-party documentation detailing the actual daily-import mechanics, supported bank list, or setup flow for generic bank/credit-card connections (only named platform integrations like Ramp/Brex/Stripe are cited). missing for 10: dedicated help-doc on bank/credit-card account connection setup, confirmation of daily auto-sync frequency, list of supported banks/institutions.
